content: Babelot usol gór
Hẽttiyaror din okkolot šara duniyair mainše šude ek zubanot hota hoito edde hitarar baša aššilde o ek ḍoilla.
Bade hitara fuk mikka agguwai zaite zaite Sinear dešot ekkan fuwainna zaga faiye edde heṛe hitara bošoti loiye.
Hitara ekzone ar ekzonore hodde, "Aiyo, ãra iṭ banai edde hinore furaidi doro gori!" Hen hoi hitara fattoror bodole iṭ edde mosollar bodole duna bebar goijje.
Hitara aro hodde, "Aiyo, ãra ekkan ãralla šohor banai ar en ekkan usol gór banai ziyanor tuliye asman suibo, toi zene ãrar nam mošuhor o, edde ãrattu šara duniyait šiṛašitta oizagoi no fore!"
Tarfore manuš okkole ze šohor edde usol gór bainde, hiyan saibolla Mabud nise laimme,
edde hodde, "So, itara beggun ek zati edde ek zubanot hota hoiya okkol, itara ei ham gora šuru goijje, bade zaiyore itara ze kissu goribolla ereda loibo, ošombob kissu no oibo.
Hetolla aiyo, ãra nise zai hitarar zubanore gulmal goridigoi toi zene hitara ekzone ar oinno zonor hota buzi no fare."
Tarfore Mabude he zagattu hitarare duniyair hár mikka šiṛašitta gori diye. Henot hitarar šohor banaibar ham bondo oi giyegoi.
Etolla he zagar nam oiyede Babel, ziyanor mani gulmal, haron Mabude šomosto duniyair zubanot gulmal bazaidiye. Mabude manuš okkolore hentu duniyair hár mikka šiṛašitta gori diye.
Šemor bongšo
In oilde Šemor bongšo okkolor kahani.
Tuwan zai dui bosor bade, Šemor boyoš ekšot bosor zẽtte oiye, hiba Arpákšador baf oiye.
Ar Šem Arpákšador baf oi bade, hiba aro fãs šot bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Arpákšad tiriš fãs bosor boyošot, hiba Šelar baf oiye.
Šelar baf oi bade, Arpákšad aro sair šo tin bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Šelah tiriš bosor boyošot, hiba Eberor baf oiye.
Ar Eberor baf oi bade, Šelah aro sair šo tin bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Eber tiriš sair bosor boyošot, hiba Felegor baf oiye.
Ar Felegor baf oi bade, Eber aro sair šo tiriš bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Feleg tiriš bosor boyošot, hiba Reuror baf oiye.
Reuror baf oi bade, Feleg dui šo no bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Reu tiriš dui bosor boyošot, Serugor baf oiye.
Serugor baf oi bade, Reu aro dui šo hãt bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Serug tiriš bosor boyošot, hiba Nahuror baf oiye.
Nahuror baf oi bade, Serug aro dui šo bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Nahur ek kuri no bosor boyošot, hiba Ṭerar baf oiye.
Ṭerar baf oi bade, Nahur aro ekšo unnuš bosor basi aššil edde aro bout futziyain okkol oiye.
Ṭerah hoittor bosor boyošot, hiba Ibraim, Nahur edde Haranor baf oiye.
Ṭerar bongšo
In oilde Ṭerar bongšor kahani.
Ṭerah aššilde Ibraim, Nahur edde Haranor baf. Ar Haran Lutor baf oiye.
Kintu Haran hibar baf Ṭerar sarme hibar zormostan, Kaldiyar Ur šohorot moron oiye.
Ibraim edde Nahur dunizone biya goijjil; Ibraimor bouwor nam aššil Sarai, ar Nahuror bou aššilde Haranor zi Milka, ar Haran aššilde Milka edde Jiskar baf.
Sarai bázá aššil, hibattu hono futziyain no o.

Ṭeraye hibar fut Ibraim edde hibar nati mani Haranor fut Lut edde hibar futor bou mani Ibraimor bou Saraire fũwati loiye edde itara beggune Kenan dešot zaibolla Kaldiyar Ur šohorottu ruwana diye. Ar hitara Harran foijjonto aiyore heṛe bošoti loiye.
Ṭerah dui šo fãs bosor baisse, edde Harranot Ṭerar moron oiye.
